## AX.25 Packet Node GB7CAM

GB7CAM is a 2m AX.25 packet radio node serving the Cambridge area.  The station provides node, mailbox and chat services using LINBPQ and is connected to the wider packet radio network via RF and IP links.

```{=html}
<script>
async function fetchWidgetTelemetry() {
  // DOM targets
  const sEl = document.getElementById("w-status");
  const lEl = document.getElementById("w-links");
  const rEl = document.getElementById("w-rf");
  const aEl = document.getElementById("w-axip");
  const tEl = document.getElementById("w-last");
  const box = document.getElementById("api-status-widget");

  const base = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";

  try {
    // Concurrent data download
    const [linksRes, mheardRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(`${base}/links`),
      fetch(`${base}/mheard`)
    ]);

    // If either endpoint fails, explicitly throw an error to trip the catch block
    if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok) throw new Error("API Connection Error");

    const linksData = await linksRes.json();
    const mheardData = await mheardRes.json();

    // Set Active Links
    lEl.innerText = linksData.links ? linksData.links.length : 0;

    // Trackers
    let rfCount = 0;
    let axipCount = 0;
    let latestTimestamp = 0;
    let latestCallsign = "None";
    const fourHoursAgo = Date.now() - (4 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    if (mheardData.mheard) {
      mheardData.mheard.forEach(station => {
        // Enforce safe UTC syntax mapping
        let rawTime = station.lastHeard;
        if (rawTime && !rawTime.endsWith('Z') && !rawTime.includes('+')) {
          rawTime += 'Z';
        }
        const parsedTime = Date.parse(rawTime);

        if (!isNaN(parsedTime)) {
          // Track the absolute newest transmission globally
          if (parsedTime > latestTimestamp) {
            latestTimestamp = parsedTime;
            latestCallsign = station.callSign || "Unknown";
          }

          // 4-Hour active user window buckets
          if (parsedTime >= fourHoursAgo) {
            const port = Number(station.port);
            if (port === 1) rfCount++;
            else if (port === 3) axipCount++;
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Output Heard Statistics
    rEl.innerText = rfCount;
    aEl.innerText = axipCount;

    // Compute relative dynamic string for the last packet window
    if (latestTimestamp > 0) {
      const diffMs = Date.now() - latestTimestamp;
      const diffMins = Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60)));
      
      if (diffMins < 1) {
        tEl.innerText = `${latestCallsign} - Just now`;
      } else if (diffMins < 60) {
        tEl.innerText = `${latestCallsign} - ${diffMins} min${diffMins > 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
      } else {
        const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
        tEl.innerText = `${latestCallsign} - ${diffHours} hour${diffHours > 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
      }
    } else {
      tEl.innerText = "No recent data";
    }

    // Enforce live success color layout styles
    sEl.innerText = "Operational";
    sEl.style.color = "#28a745";
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#28a745";

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Widget engine failure:", error);
    
    // Graceful error state adjustments - Switches layout to "Under Maintenance"
    sEl.innerText = "Under Maintenance";
    sEl.style.color = "#dc3545";
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#dc3545";
    
    // Clear the numbers out so old or invalid data is not shown when offline
    lEl.innerText = "—";
    rEl.innerText = "—";
    aEl.innerText = "—";
    tEl.innerText = "Offline";
  }
}

// Initialize on page assembly completed and set up the 60-second loop
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchWidgetTelemetry(); // Run immediately on load
  setInterval(fetchWidgetTelemetry, 60000); // Run every 60,000 milliseconds (60 seconds)
});
</script>
